name: Amikacin
description: Prescription antibacterial used for selected serious bacterial infections
contraindications: Serious aminoglycoside allergy; renal or hearing risk needs review
interactions: Avoid other nephrotoxic or ototoxic drugs unless monitored
side_effects: Kidney injury; hearing or balance changes

name: Amoxicillin
description: Penicillin antibacterial used for susceptible bacterial infections
contraindications: Serious penicillin allergy
interactions: Check anticoagulants and duplicate beta-lactam therapy

name: Ampicillin
description: Penicillin antibacterial used for susceptible bacterial infections
contraindications: Serious penicillin allergy
interactions: Check anticoagulants and duplicate beta-lactam therapy

name: Azithromycin
description: Macrolide antibacterial used for selected bacterial infections
contraindications: Macrolide allergy; rhythm or liver conditions need review
interactions: Check QT-prolonging drugs; avoid duplicate macrolide therapy

name: Cefazolin
description: First-generation cephalosporin antibacterial
contraindications: Serious cephalosporin or beta-lactam allergy
interactions: Check anticoagulants and duplicate beta-lactam therapy

name: Cefepime
description: Fourth-generation cephalosporin antibacterial
contraindications: Serious cephalosporin or beta-lactam allergy; renal dosing needs review
interactions: Check other medicines affecting the nervous system or kidney

name: Cefixime
description: Third-generation cephalosporin antibacterial
contraindications: Serious cephalosporin or beta-lactam allergy
interactions: Check anticoagulants and duplicate beta-lactam therapy

name: Ceftriaxone
description: Third-generation cephalosporin antibacterial
contraindications: Serious cephalosporin or beta-lactam allergy
interactions: Check calcium-containing IV products and duplicate beta-lactams

name: Ciprofloxacin
description: Fluoroquinolone antibacterial used for selected infections
contraindications: Fluoroquinolone allergy; tendon or rhythm risks need review
interactions: Separate from antacids, iron or calcium; check QT-prolonging drugs

name: Clarithromycin
description: Macrolide antibacterial used for selected bacterial infections
contraindications: Macrolide allergy; rhythm or liver conditions need review
interactions: Check QT-prolonging drugs and medicines metabolized by CYP3A4

name: Clindamycin
description: Lincosamide antibacterial used for susceptible infections
contraindications: Serious clindamycin or lincomycin allergy
interactions: Tell the clinician about medicines that affect neuromuscular function

name: Daptomycin
description: Cyclic lipopeptide antibacterial for selected serious infections
contraindications: Serious daptomycin allergy; muscle disease needs review
interactions: Check statins and other medicines affecting muscle
side_effects: Muscle pain; raised muscle enzymes; injection reactions

name: Doxycycline
description: Tetracycline antibacterial used for susceptible bacterial infections
contraindications: Tetracycline allergy; pregnancy or young-child use needs review
interactions: Separate from antacids, iron, calcium or magnesium

name: Ertapenem
description: Carbapenem antibacterial for selected serious infections
contraindications: Serious beta-lactam allergy; seizure risk needs review
interactions: Check valproate because levels may fall; review other beta-lactams

name: Gentamicin
description: Aminoglycoside antibacterial for selected serious infections
contraindications: Serious aminoglycoside allergy; renal or hearing risk needs review
interactions: Avoid other nephrotoxic or ototoxic drugs unless monitored
side_effects: Kidney injury; hearing or balance changes

name: Imipenem
description: Carbapenem antibacterial usually administered with cilastatin
contraindications: Serious beta-lactam allergy; seizure risk needs review
interactions: Check valproate because levels may fall; review other beta-lactams

name: Levofloxacin
description: Fluoroquinolone antibacterial used for selected infections
contraindications: Fluoroquinolone allergy; tendon or rhythm risks need review
interactions: Separate from antacids, iron or calcium; check QT-prolonging drugs

name: Linezolid
description: Oxazolidinone antibacterial for selected resistant infections
contraindications: Serious linezolid allergy; uncontrolled hypertension needs review
interactions: Avoid MAO inhibitors and review serotonergic or adrenergic medicines

name: Meropenem
description: Carbapenem antibacterial for selected serious infections
contraindications: Serious beta-lactam allergy; seizure risk needs review
interactions: Check valproate because levels may fall; review other beta-lactams

name: Metronidazole
description: Nitroimidazole antimicrobial used for selected anaerobic and parasitic infections
contraindications: Nitroimidazole allergy; certain neurologic or liver conditions need review
interactions: Avoid alcohol during treatment and for the label-specified interval; check warfarin

name: Nitrofurantoin
description: Nitrofuran antibacterial commonly used for selected urinary infections
contraindications: Severe renal impairment or nitrofurantoin allergy needs review
interactions: Check antacids and medicines that affect kidney function
side_effects: Nausea; headache; lung or liver symptoms

name: Oxacillin
description: Penicillinase-resistant penicillin antibacterial
contraindications: Serious penicillin allergy
interactions: Check anticoagulants and duplicate beta-lactam therapy

name: Piperacillin/Tazobactam
description: Combination antibacterial used for selected serious infections
contraindications: Serious penicillin or beta-lactam allergy; renal dosing needs review
interactions: Check anticoagulants, kidney-toxic drugs and duplicate beta-lactams

name: Rifampin
description: Rifamycin antibacterial used in specific treatment regimens
contraindications: Rifamycin allergy; liver disease or interacting medicines need review
interactions: Strong enzyme inducer: check anticoagulants, contraceptives and antivirals
side_effects: Liver injury; orange body fluids; nausea

name: Vancomycin
description: Glycopeptide antibacterial for selected serious gram-positive infections
contraindications: Serious vancomycin allergy; renal or hearing risk needs review
interactions: Avoid other nephrotoxic or ototoxic drugs unless monitored
side_effects: Kidney injury; infusion reaction; hearing changes
